placements.note: Placed at the DESY Hamburg campus site (campus-grade): the East and West halls of the HERA ring have no coordinate in any fetched source (OpenStreetMap names only the North hall and a building "HERA West 50", whose position does not fit the ring geometry), so no hall point is asserted.
placements.quote: The HERA-B experiment [19,20] in the West Hall was built to use collisions of the proton beam halo with a wire target in order to produce B-mesons for the study of CP violation in the B − B̄ system.

summary.plain: A large forward spectrometer built around thin wire targets in the proton beam halo, with a silicon vertex detector, tracking chambers, particle identification and calorimeters.
summary.technical: HERA-B: vertex detector, extensive tracking and particle-identification systems with large geometrical acceptance (up to 160 mrad vertically), target system of two stations of four wires.

technology.quote: The HERA-B fixed-target spectrometer operated at the 920 GeV/c proton beam of the HERA storage ring at DESY using one or more wire targets inserted into the beam halo.
technology.value: Forward fixed-target spectrometer with wire targets, vertex detector and extensive tracking and particle identification
